rules: Use the warm cream paper background (#F2EEDF) on every standard slide.
Use Cormorant Garamond at weight 500 for every headline; italic <em> phrases drop to weight 400.
Use Work Sans only for body, eyebrows, card sub-labels, and attributions.
Default cards to translucent white (rgba(255,255,255,0.55)) at 24–36px border-radius.
Pastel fills (pink, lemon, blush, sage, lilac) are interchangeable card accents with no fixed semantic meaning.
Text stays ink (#2A241B) on every surface, including all pastel cards. Never invert to white.
Use italic serif (Cormorant Garamond italic) for kickers, markers, page numerals, footers, step numerals, and sign-offs.
Use lowercase Roman numerals (i., ii., iii.) for step ordinals.
No drop shadows. Depth comes from translucency and rounded form only.
No square corners. Minimum acceptable radius is 14px; cards live at 22–36px.

frames.purpose: Opening title slide with large serif headline, kicker, lede, and cover swatch row.
Two-column foreword with drop-cap opener and narrative body.
Four-step method grid with pastel step cards and Roman numerals.
Three insight cards with serif headlines and sub-labels.
Full-bleed pink statement slide for a key insight or moment.
Statistical summary with oversized numerals on pastel cards.
Centered pull-quote with large blush quote mark and attribution.
Next-steps slide with headline panel and three action items.
Dense consulting-style finding page with three evidence columns and action bar.
Chart slide with narrative left panel and rendered chart right panel.
Five-step process diagram with pastel nodes and timeline bar.
Comparison matrix with row labels, column headers, and status pills.

known_gaps: The current PPTX uses screenshot backgrounds, so decorative elements and baked text in the background are not directly editable.
Editable text boxes are overlaid from DOM text-node coordinates, but PowerPoint font availability may differ from browser-rendered web fonts.
Generated production decks should eventually render slide-specific backgrounds from generated content or hide baked text before overlaying visible editable text.
